title: Valuing Ecosystem Services with Fishery Rents: A Lumped-Parameter Approach to Hypoxia in the Neuse River Estuary
abstract: Valuing ecosystem services with microeconomic underpinnings presents challenges because these services typically constitute nonmarket values and contribute to human welfare indirectly through a series of ecological pathways that are dynamic, nonlinear, and difficult to quantify and link to appropriate economic spatial and temporal scales. This paper develops and demonstrates a method to value a portion of ecosystem services when a commercial fishery is dependent on the quality of estuarine habitat. Using a lumped-parameter, dynamic open access bioeconomic model that is spatially explicit and includes predator-prey interactions, this paper quantifies part of the value of improved ecosystem function in the Neuse River Estuary when nutrient pollution is reduced. Specifically, it traces the effects of nitrogen loading on the North Carolina commercial blue crab fishery by modeling the response of primary production and the subsequent impact on hypoxia (low dissolved oxygen). Hypoxia, in turn, affects blue crabs and their preferred prey. The discounted present value fishery rent increase from a 30% reduction in nitrogen loadings in the Neuse is $2.56 million, though this welfare estimate is fairly sensitive to some parameter values. Surprisingly, this number is not sensitive to initial conditions.
abstract_zh: 对生态系统服务进行价值评估，需要具有微观经济基础，但这一任务颇具挑战，因为这些服务通常属于非市场价值，并且通过一系列动态的、非线性的生态路径间接影响人类福利，而这些路径难以量化，也难以与适当的经济空间和时间尺度相衔接。本文提出并演示了一种方法，用以评估商业渔业依赖于河口栖息地质量时所对应的部分生态系统服务价值。本文使用一个集总参数、动态的开放准入生物经济模型，该模型具有空间明确性并包含捕食者—被捕食者的相互作用，用以量化纽斯河口（Neuse River Estuary）在营养物污染减少时生态功能改善的部分价值。具体而言，本文追踪了氮负荷如何影响北卡罗来纳州商业蓝蟹渔业，模拟了初级生产力的响应及其对缺氧（溶解氧含量低）的后续影响。缺氧进而影响蓝蟹及其偏好的猎物。若纽斯河口的氮负荷减少30%，渔业租金现值将增加256万美元，但这一福利估计对部分参数值较为敏感。令人惊讶的是，该数值对初始条件并不敏感。

title: Coastal sustainability depends on how economic and coastline responses to climate change affect each other
abstract: Human-induced climate change is predicted to accelerate sea level rise and alter storm frequency along the US east coast. Rising sea level will enhance shoreline erosion, and recent work indicates changing storm patterns and associated changes in wave conditions can intensify coastal erosion along parts of a coastline. Investigations of coastal response to climate change typically consider natural processes in isolationneglecting repeated changes to the coastline from human actions, primarily through shoreline nourishment projects, which add sand to the shoreline to counteract erosion. In a model coupling economically driven shoreline nourishment with wave-and sea level rise-driven coastline change, and accounting for dwindling sediment resources for nourishment, coastline response depends dramatically on the relationship between patterns of property value and erosion. Simulations show that when nourishment costs rise with depletion of sand resources, coastline change is tied to the interaction between patterns of erosion and property value. Simulations show that when high property values align with highly erosive locations, sand resources are depleted rapidly and nourishment in lower property value towns is quickly abandoned. Although our model simulates a particular coastal morphology, the result that future behavior of the coastline and the economic viability of nourishment in a given town depend on the regional interaction between patterns of property value and erosion is likely applicable to many coastal configurations. More broadly, coupling economic and physical models reveals equity and sustainability implications of coastal climate adaptation as well as patterns of coastline change that a physical model alone would overlook.
abstract_zh: 据预测，人为引起的气候变化将加速海平面上升，并改变美国东海岸的风暴频率。海平面上升将加剧海岸侵蚀，而近期研究表明，风暴模式的变化及由此带来的波浪条件变化，可能加剧海岸线部分区域的侵蚀。对沿海气候变化响应的研究通常孤立地考虑自然过程，忽视了人类行为（主要通过海岸养护工程，即向海岸添加沙子以抵消侵蚀）对海岸线造成的反复改变。在一个耦合了经济驱动的海岸养护与波浪及海平面上升驱动的海岸线变化的模型中，并考虑到用于养护的沙源日益枯竭，海岸线响应极大地取决于房产价值格局与侵蚀格局之间的关系。模拟结果表明，当养护成本随沙源耗竭而上升时，海岸线变化与侵蚀格局和房产价值格局之间的相互作用密切相关。模拟还表明，当高房产价值与高侵蚀地点重合时，沙源会迅速耗竭，而低房产价值城镇的养护工作很快就会被放弃。尽管我们的模型模拟的是某一特定的海岸地貌，但以下结论很可能适用于许多其他沿海地形：某一城镇的海岸线未来行为及其养护的经济可行性，取决于该地区房产价值格局与侵蚀格局之间的相互作用。更广泛地说，耦合经济模型与物理模型，揭示了沿海气候适应的公平与可持续性含义，以及仅靠物理模型可能忽略的海岸线变化模式。

title: Economics. Sustainability and global seafood
Genetically Modified Salmon and Full Impact Assessment
Political economy of marine reserves: understanding the role of opportunity costs
venue: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
abstract: The creation of marine reserves is often controversial. For decisionmakers, trying to find compromises, an understanding of the timing, magnitude, and incidence of the costs of a reserve is critical. Understanding the costs, in turn, requires consideration of not just the direct financial costs but also the opportunity costs associated with reserves. We use a discrete choice model of commercial fishermen’s behavior to examine both the short-run and long-run opportunity costs of marine reserves. Our results can help policymakers recognize the factors influencing commercial fishermen’s responses to reserve proposals. More generally, we highlight the potential drivers behind the political economy of marine reserves.
abstract_zh: 海洋保护区的设立常常引起争议。对于试图寻求妥协的决策者而言，理解保护区成本的时机、规模和负担分布至关重要。理解成本，则不仅需要考虑直接的财务成本，还需要考虑与保护区相关的机会成本。我们利用商业渔民行为的离散选择模型，考察海洋保护区的短期和长期机会成本。我们的结果有助于决策者认识影响商业渔民对保护区方案作出反应的因素。更一般地说，我们揭示了海洋保护区政治经济学背后的潜在驱动因素。

title: Quantifying the Economic Effects of Hypoxia on a Fishery for Brown Shrimp, Farfantepenaeus aztecus
venue: Marine and Coastal Fisheries: Dynamics, Management, and Ecosystem Science
abstract: Although hypoxia is a threat to coastal ecosystems, policy makers have limited information about its economic impacts on fisheries. Studies using spatially and temporally aggregated data generally fail to detect statistically significant effects of hypoxia on fisheries. Limited recent work using disaggregated fishing data (microdata) has revealed modest effects of hypoxia on the catches of recreationally harvested species. These studies did not account for important spatial and temporal aspects of the system, however. For example, the effects of hypoxia on catch may not materialize instantaneously but involve a lagged process reflecting cumulative past exposure. This paper develops a differenced bioeconomic model to account for the lagged effects of hypoxia on the North Carolina fishery for brown shrimp Farfantepenaeus aztecus. The model integrates high-resolution oxygen monitoring data with fishery-dependent microdata from North Carolina's trip ticket program to investigate the detailed spatial and temporal relationships of hypoxia to commercial fishery harvests. The main finding is that hypoxia may have resulted in a 12.9% annual decrease in the brown shrimp harvest during the period 1999–2005. The paper also develops two alternative models—a nondifferenced model and a polynomial distributed lag model—whose results are consistent with those of the main model.
abstract_zh: 尽管缺氧是对沿海生态系统的威胁，政策制定者对其经济影响的信息却十分有限。使用空间和时间上加总的数据进行的研究，通常无法检测到缺氧对渔业产生的统计显著影响。近期一些利用分解程度较高的渔业数据（微观数据）的有限研究，发现缺氧对休闲捕捞物种的渔获量有适度影响。然而，这些研究未能考虑系统中重要的空间和时间维度。例如，缺氧对渔获量的影响可能不会立即显现，而是涉及反映过去累积暴露的滞后过程。本文构建了一个差分生物经济模型，以考虑缺氧对北卡罗来纳州褐对虾（Farfantepenaeus aztecus）渔业的滞后效应。该模型整合了高分辨率的氧气监测数据与北卡罗来纳州渔获单计划（trip ticket program）中依赖渔业的微观数据，以考察缺氧与商业渔获之间详细的空间和时间关系。主要发现是，在1999—2005年期间，缺氧可能导致褐对虾年渔获量下降12.9%。本文还构建了两种替代模型——非差分模型和多项式分布滞后模型——其结果与主模型一致。

title: Toward an Econometric Foundation for Marine Ecosystem-based Management
Beach nourishment as a dynamic capital accumulation problem
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Beach nourishment is a common coastal management strategy used to combat erosion along sandy coastlines. It involves building out a beach with sand dredged from another location. This paper develops a positive model of beach nourishment and generates testable hypotheses about how the frequency of nourishment responds to property values, project costs, erosion rates, and discounting. By treating the decision to nourish as a dynamic capital accumulation problem, the model produces new insights about coupled economic geomorphological systems. In particular, determining whether the frequency of nourishment increases in response to physical and economic forces depends on whether the decay rate of nourishment sand exceeds the discount rate. © 2009 Elsevier Inc. All rights reserved.

title: The economics of spatial-dynamic processes: Applications to renewable resources
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: An empirical approach to ecosystem-based fishery management
Bioeconometrics: Empirical Modeling of Bioeconomic Systems
Econometric Modeling of Fisheries with Complex Life Histories: Avoiding Biological Management Failures
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Economics of the fishery has focused on the wastefulness of common pool resource exploitation. Pure open access fisheries dissipate economic rents and degrade biological stocks. Biologically managed fisheries also dissipate rents but are thought to hold biological stocks at desired levels. We develop and estimate an empirical bioeconomic model of the Gulf of Mexico gag fishery that questions the presumptive success of biological management. Unlike previous bioeconomic life history studies, we provide a way to circumvent calibration problems by embedding our estimation routine directly in the dynamic bioeconomic model. We nest a standard biological management model that accounts for complex life history characteristics of the gag. Biological intuition suggests that a spawning season closure will reduce fishing pressure and increase stocks, and simulations of the biological management model confirm this finding. However, simulations of the empirical bioeconomic model show that these intended outcomes of the spawning closure do not materialize. The behavioral response to the closure is so pronounced that it offsets the restriction in allowable fishing days. Our results suggest that failure to account for fishing behavior plays an important role in fishery management failures.
abstract_zh: 渔业经济学长期关注公共池塘资源开发中的浪费问题。纯粹的开放准入渔业会耗散经济租金，并使生物种群退化。实行生物管理的渔业同样会耗散租金，但人们通常认为，它能使生物种群维持在理想水平。我们构建并估计了墨西哥湾石斑鱼（gag）渔业的实证生物经济模型，对生物管理的既定成功提出了质疑。与以往复杂生活史的生物经济研究不同，我们通过将估计程序直接嵌入动态生物经济模型之中，规避了校准问题。我们嵌入了一个标准的生物管理模型，该模型考虑了石斑鱼复杂的生活史特征。生物学直觉认为，产卵季禁渔将减少捕捞压力并增加种群存量，而生物管理模型的模拟也证实了这一结论。然而，实证生物经济模型的模拟显示，禁渔的预期结果并未出现。捕捞行为的反应非常显著，足以抵消允许捕捞天数的限制。我们的结果表明，忽视捕捞行为在渔业管理失败中起着重要作用。

title: Synergies Between Adjacent Beach-Nourishing Communities in a Morpho-economic Coupled Coastline Model
Generating value in habitat-dependent fisheries: The importance of fishery management institutions
abstract: This paper models dynamic producer and consumer benefits from improving habitat that supports the North Carolina blue crab fishery. It embeds two fishery management institutions—open access and partial rationalization—in a multispecies, two-patch spatial bioeconomic model with endogenous output price and estuarine eutrophication. Producer benefits from improved environmental quality are higher for the rationalized fishery than for open access. Consumer benefits are larger than producer benefits and are comparable across institutions. However, the total benefits from improving environmental quality are small relative to the benefits from rationalizing the fishery and leaving environmental quality the same. (JEL Q22)
abstract_zh: 本文模拟了改善支撑北卡罗来纳州蓝蟹渔业的栖息地所带来的生产者和消费者的动态收益。本文在一个多物种、双斑块的空间生物经济模型中，嵌入了两种渔业管理制度——开放准入和部分理顺（partial rationalization）——该模型纳入了内生的产出价格和河口富营养化。与开放准入相比，理顺后的渔业中，环境质量改善给生产者带来的收益更高。消费者收益大于生产者收益，且在各制度之间相当。然而，相对于在保持环境质量不变的情况下理顺渔业所带来的收益，改善环境质量所带来的总收益较小。（JEL Q22）

title: Open access in a spatially delineated artisanal fishery: The case of Minahasa, Indonesia
abstract: The effects of economic development on the exploitation of renewable resources are investigated in settings where property rights are ill defined or not enforced. This paper explores potential conservation implications from labor and product market developments, such as enhanced transportation infrastructure. A model is developed that predicts individual fish catch per unit effort based on characteristics of individual fishermen and the development status of their villages. The econometric model is estimated using data from a cross-sectional household survey of artisanal coral reef fishermen in Minahasa, Indonesia, taking account of fishermen heterogeneity. Variation across different villages and across fishermen within the villages is used to explore the effects of development. Strong evidence is found for the countervailing forces of product and labor market effects on the exploitation of a coral reef fishery.
abstract_zh: 在产权界定不清或执行不力的环境中，经济发展对可再生资源开发的影响得到了研究。本文探讨了劳动力和产品市场发展（如交通基础设施的改善）可能带来的保护含义。我们构建了一个模型，根据个体渔民的特征及其所在村庄的发展状况，预测个体渔获的单位捕捞努力量。计量模型使用印度尼西亚米纳哈萨（Minahasa）小规模珊瑚礁渔民的横截面家庭调查数据进行估计，并考虑了渔民的异质性。利用不同村庄之间以及同一村庄内渔民之间的差异，考察发展的影响。研究发现，有力证据表明，产品市场效应与劳动力市场效应对珊瑚礁渔业的开发具有相互抵消的作用。

title: Structural Modeling of Marine Reserves with Bayesian Estimation
Effectiveness of marine reserves for large-scale fisheries management
venue: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
abstract: As more no-take marine reserves are established, the importance of evaluating effectiveness retrospectively is growing. This paper adapts methods from program evaluation to quantify the effects of establishing a marine reserve on fisheries using fishery-dependent data. The approach analyzes the effects of a policy at the individual vessel level and accommodates the coarse spatial resolution of fishing logbooks. It illuminates implicit assumptions in previous retrospective analyses of marine reserves that are unlikely to hold for large-scale fisheries. We illustrate the empirical model with an application to the Gulf of Mexico reef-fish fishery. Isolating the effects of reserves requires a full accounting of multiple gear production technologies, heterogeneity in vessel captain skill, spatial heterogeneity of fish stocks, seasonal patterns in abundance, the effects of coexisting management policies, and the possibility that the harvest sector anticipates reserve establishment. We find that the effect of two recently established marine reserves on catch is negative and trending downward, though the reserves have only been in place for 4.5 years.
abstract_zh: 随着越来越多的禁渔海洋保护区被设立，对其成效进行回顾性评估的重要性日益提升。本文借鉴项目评估的方法，利用依赖渔业的数据，量化设立海洋保护区对渔业的影响。该方法在船只个体层面分析政策效果，并兼容渔捞日志的粗空间分辨率。它揭示了以往海洋保护区回顾性分析中的隐含假设，而这些假设对于大规模渔业而言未必成立。我们以墨西哥湾礁鱼渔业的应用来说明该实证模型。要分离保护区的效果，需要充分考虑多种渔具生产技术、船长技能的异质性、鱼类资源的空间异质性、丰度的季节性模式、并存管理政策的影响，以及捕捞部门可能预期保护区设立的情况。我们发现，两个近期设立的海洋保护区对渔获量的影响为负且呈下降趋势，尽管这些保护区仅实施了4.5年。

title: Fishing Yield, Curvature, and Spatial Behavior: Implications for Modeling Marine Reserves
Limited Entry Licensing: Insights from a Duration Model
Marine Reserves with Endogenous Ports: Empirical Bioeconomics of the California Sea Urchin Fishery
abstract: Marine reserves are gaining substantial public support as tools for commercial fisheries management. Harvest sector responses will influence policy performance, yet biological studies often depict harvester behavior as spread uniformly over fishing grounds and unresponsive to economic opportunities. Previous bioeconomic analyses show that these behavioral assumptions are inconsistent with empirical data and, more importantly, lead to overly optimistic predictions about harvest gains from reserves. This paper adds another layer of behavioral realism to the bioeconomics of marine reserves by endogenizing fisher home port choices with a partial adjustment share model. Estimated with Seemingly Unrelated Regression over monthly data, this approach allows simulation of both short- and long-run behavioral response to changes induced by marine reserve formation. The findings cast further doubt on the notion that marine reserves generate long-run harvest benefits.
abstract_zh: 海洋保护区作为商业渔业管理工具，正获得大量公众支持。捕捞部门的反应将影响政策绩效，然而生物学研究往往将捕捞者的行为描述为在渔场上均匀分布，并且对经济机会缺乏反应。先前的生物经济分析表明，这些行为假设与实证数据不一致，并且更重要的是，会导致对保护区带来捕捞收益的过度乐观预测。本文通过采用部分调整份额模型将渔民的母港选择内生化，为海洋保护区的生物经济学增添了另一层行为现实性。该方法使用月度数据通过似不相关回归（SUR）进行估计，能够模拟海洋保护区形成所引起的变化在短期和长期的行为反应。研究结果进一步动摇了海洋保护区能够带来长期捕捞收益这一观点。

title: Economic Impacts of Marine Reserves: The Importance of Spatial Behavior
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Avoiding surprises: Incorporating fisherman behavior into management models
abstract: All fisheries-management models incorporate simplifying assumptions about ecological and oceanographic mechanisms that are fundamentally uncertain or stochastic, but exploited fisheries are also subject to equally important uncertainties associated with fisherman behavior. Fishermen make decisions ranging from long-term entry/exit decisions to daily or even hourly decisions about where and how to fish. These decisions are influenced by regulations, technology, weather, and expectations about prices, costs, and abundance. They ultimately determine the spatial and temporal pattern of mortality in an exploited fishery. Although biologists have tried to incorporate fisherman behavior into management models, much of the work is ad hoc, whereas economics has a rich tradition of both conceptual and empirical behavioral modeling. This paper is an attempt to demonstrate the potential usefulness of economics-based behavioral modeling, with data collected for biological management. A model of participation and spatial choice is constructed, and the economic model is linked to a biological model of metapopulation dynamics and used to forecast the implications of management measures that might be applied to the red sea urchin fishery in California. The results show that modeling spatial behavior strongly affects the predicted outcomes of management policies even if the policies are not spatial in character.
abstract_zh: 所有渔业管理模型都包含关于生态和海洋机制的简化假设，这些机制本身存在根本性的不确定或随机性；但被开发利用的渔业同样面临与渔民行为相关的、同样重要的不确定性。渔民的决策范围从长期的进入与退出决定，到每日甚至每小时关于在何处以及如何捕捞的决定。这些决策受到法规、技术、天气以及对价格、成本和资源丰度预期的影响。它们最终决定了被开发渔业中死亡率的空间和时间格局。尽管生物学家曾尝试将渔民行为纳入管理模型，但大多数此类工作都是临时性的，而经济学则拥有丰富的概念性和实证性行为建模传统。本文试图展示基于经济学的行为建模的潜在用途，所用数据原本是为生物管理而收集的。我们构建了一个参与和空间选择模型，并将该经济模型与一个生物种群动态模型相连接，用以预测可能适用于加利福尼亚红海胆渔业的管理措施的影响。结果表明，即使政策本身并不具有空间属性，对空间行为的建模也会强烈影响管理政策的预测结果。

title: Entry and exit in California's organic farming sector
venue: Advances in the Economics of Environmental Resources
abstract: In California, organic acreage increased by 60% and sales of organic commodities increased by 110% between 1992 and 1997. The rate of growth in the organic industry does not reveal the dynamic nature of California's organic agriculture. In this chapter, we explore the characteristics of farmers entering and exiting the organic market in California. In so doing, our analysis provides insight into the impact of policy and growth on the future composition of the organic industry.
abstract_zh: 在加利福尼亚，1992年至1997年间，有机耕地面积增长了60%，有机农产品销售额增长了110%。有机产业的增长速度并未揭示加利福尼亚有机农业的动态本质。在本章中，我们探讨进入和退出加利福尼亚有机市场的农民的特征。通过这一分析，我们得以洞察政策和增长如何影响有机产业未来的构成。

title: The Marine Environment: Fencing the Last Frontier
abstract: Fisheries resources contribute a valuable source of protein to the world's food supply. While there is much promise for continued production gains from aquaculture and terrestrial sources, the marine fisheries sector faces a number of critical current policy junctures. Since extension of jurisdiction to 200 miles in 1976, there have been dramatic changes in the opportunity for coastal nations to rationally manage formerly open access marine resources. While more spatially encompassing management has brought physical yield close to full biological potential, much of the potential economic yield from fisheries is still squandered. An important issue is whether the future potential of marine resources will be guided by an expansion of private property rights or by an expansion of bureaucratic regulatory structures. New monitoring, information, and enforcement technology is making it increasingly possible to zone the ocean and implement measures that mimic terrestrial property systems. At the same time, there is opposition to privatizing marine resources by groups who view them as public resources. The outcome of the tussle between the forces supporting and opposing property rights creation will largely determine the extent and kinds of values that will be generated from marine resources around the world in the next decade.
abstract_zh: 渔业资源是世界粮食供给中宝贵的蛋白质来源。尽管水产养殖和陆地来源仍有望持续增产，但海洋渔业部门正面临若干关键的当前政策节点。自1976年将管辖权延伸至200海里以来，沿海国家合理管理原本开放准入的海洋资源的机会发生了巨大变化。虽然空间范围更广的管理已使实际产量接近生物学上的最大潜力，但渔业的许多潜在经济产量仍在被浪费。一个重要问题是，海洋资源的未来潜力将由私人产权的扩张来引导，还是由官僚式监管结构的扩张来引导。新的监测、信息和执法技术，使分区划分海洋并实施模仿陆地产权制度的措施变得日益可行。与此同时，也有一些团体反对将海洋资源私有化，认为海洋资源是公共资源。支持与反对产权创设的两种力量之间的较量，将在很大程度上决定未来十年全球海洋资源能够产生的价值的范围与类型。

title: Two Econometric Approaches for Predicting the Spatial Behavior of Renewable Resource Harvesters
abstract: This paper analyzes spatial patterns of exploitation in the California sea urchin fishery using two different econometric approaches: a combined count data and SUR model of monthly observations and a micro-level Nested Logit model of individual harvester daily decisions. Each model is used to simulate the spatial distribution of fishing effort. The models are compared using goodness of fit measures and implications for management are discussed. (JEL Q22)
abstract_zh: 本文运用两种不同的计量方法，分析加利福尼亚红海胆渔业的开发空间格局：一是对月度观测值进行的组合计数数据与似不相关回归（SUR）模型，二是对个体捕捞者每日决策进行的微观层面嵌套Logit模型。每个模型都用于模拟捕捞努力的空间分布。我们利用拟合优度指标对模型进行比较，并讨论其对管理的含义。（JEL Q22）

title: Breeding Incentives and the Demand for California Thoroughbred Racing: Is there a Quality/Quantity Tradeoff?
Spatial search and fishing location choice: Methodological challenges of empirical modeling
abstract: Discrete choice modeling of fishing location tries to resolve simultaneously behavioral responses to information, what this information is, and the way that the information is gathered and processed. Without observing the process itself, the modeler really only sees choices and revenue (or catch) histories. We cannot separate how these histories are combined into measures of profitability and how these measures affect choice. This paper discussed two fundamentally different attempts to resolve questions about information. The author concludes that structural attempts are essentially intractable in every setting, and reduced-form methods are by nature ad hoc. Nevertheless, some hope lies in reduced-form methods. A conclusion of the first section is that even ad hoc approaches to information processing should account for sampling variance in addition to variance of the underlying stochastic process. Of the methods discussed, the Bayesian approach with a realistic probability model seems most compelling but is also the most difficult to implement. In contrast, it is much less clear how best to model the decay of information.

title: Success or Selection: An Economic Perspective on Fisheries Co-Management
